success.title: Payment Successful!
success.message: Your subscription has been activated. Welcome to Jawab24!
success.returnToApp: Payment received — you can return to the Jawab24 app now.

cancel.title: Payment Canceled
cancel.message: Your payment was canceled. No charges were made to your account.

return.incompleteMessage: Your payment was not completed. No charges were made to your account.
return.expiredMessage: This checkout session has expired. Please try again.

unavailable.title: Payments are not available in your region
unavailable.message: Due to regulatory requirements, payment processing is not available in your geographic location at this time. Contact us via WhatsApp to arrange an alternative payment method.
unavailable.support: We typically respond within a few hours during business hours.
unavailable.localAlternative: Payment from inside Syria is possible via Sham Cash. Contact support for the details.
unavailable.whatsappMessagePricing: Hi, I have a question about Jawab24 pricing and payment.
unavailable.whatsappMessageCheckout: Hi, I'd like to complete my Jawab24 subscription and have a question about payment.

shamCash.title: Pay with Sham Cash
shamCash.intro: Cards are not available in your region, but you can pay for your subscription by transferring to our Sham Cash wallet.
shamCash.step1: Transfer the amount to the wallet above.
shamCash.step2: Copy the transfer reference from your Sham Cash receipt.
shamCash.step3: Send it here, and we activate your account after we confirm the transfer.
shamCash.qrHint: Scanning from another phone? Use the code above.
shamCash.amountNote: The price is in US dollars. Transfer the equivalent amount in your wallet currency.
shamCash.referenceHint: The reference number on your transfer receipt. We use it to find your payment.
shamCash.senderPlaceholder: The name the transfer was sent from
shamCash.receiptHint: A screenshot of the transfer. Only our support team can see it.
shamCash.orWhatsApp: Or send the receipt on WhatsApp
shamCash.pendingBody: We received your transfer details and are confirming them. Your account is activated as soon as the transfer is confirmed — usually within a few hours during business hours.
shamCash.rejectedTitle: We could not confirm this transfer
shamCash.rejectedBody: Check the reference and send it again, or contact support on WhatsApp.
shamCash.errorDuplicate: This transfer reference has already been submitted. We are reviewing it — no need to transfer again.
shamCash.errorTooManyPending: You already have transfers awaiting review. Contact support if something looks wrong.
shamCash.errorImageTooLarge: The image is too large (max 2 MB).
shamCash.errorImageType: Use a JPG, PNG, or WEBP image.
shamCash.errorGeneric: We could not send your details. Try again.
shamCash.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
